PTA_KONNI.desc: Meet the young elephants at Konni's 1942 timber elephant kraal, spin down the forest-lined Kallar river in a round bamboo coracle at Adavi, then visit the riverside forest shrine at Kalleli.
PTA_KONNI.itin:
7:30 AM — Pickup: Pathanamthitta KSRTC stand · Thiruvalla station · Chengannur station (Thiruvalla 7:30 · Chengannur 7:50 · PTA 8:30)
9:00 AM — Konni Elephant Camp: The old Anakoodu timber kraal, the calves at feeding and bath time, and a small elephant museum. (Entry own expense)
11:00 AM — Adavi coracle ride: Round bamboo boats on the Kallar river through bamboo and forest. Lunch in Konni after, own expense. (Ride paid direct)
2:30 PM — Kalleli forest shrine: Oorali Appooppan Kavu on the Achankovil river — a forest shrine with old tribal-rooted rituals. (Modest dress)
5:30 PM — Drop-off: Pathanamthitta, Thiruvalla, Chengannur, or your own stop on the way
PTA_KONNI.gtk:
🐘 Elephant camp: Open from 9 AM. Some listings show a Monday closure — we confirm the camp is open before your date. Watch from the railings; feed or touch the elephants only if the keepers allow it.
🛶 Coracle ride: Run by the forest department's eco-tourism team; short and long rides, paid direct at the counter. Life jackets on. Rides can stop when the river is high after heavy rain.
🌳 Forest day: Leeches in the monsoon months — wear closed shoes and carry repellent. Mobile signal is weak at Adavi and Kalleli; stay with the group.
🚉 Pickup points: Thiruvalla first, then Chengannur, then Pathanamthitta — we share exact times the evening before. Drop-off in the reverse order, or at your own stop on the way.
PTA_KONNI.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Free drop within the city; Caretaker for 10+ guests
PTA_KONNI.exc: Lunch; Elephant camp entry and coracle fare; Tolls and parking (private trips)
PTA_KONNI.carry: Closed shoes or sandals with grip; Insect / leech repellent; Cash for tickets and the boat; A change of clothes (boat splashes)

PTA_ARANMULA.desc: Old temples and older churches along the Pampa: Chengannur Mahadeva, Aranmula's snake-boat temple and its famous metal mirror, then the pilgrim churches of Parumala and Niranam.
PTA_ARANMULA.itin:
7:00 AM — Pickup: Pathanamthitta KSRTC stand · Thiruvalla station · Chengannur station (PTA 7:00 · Thiruvalla 7:45 · Chengannur 8:05)
8:15 AM — Chengannur Mahadeva Temple: A grand Kerala temple of Shiva and Parvati, busiest at the morning poojas. (Dress code · see below)
9:40 AM — Aranmula Parthasarathy Temple: Krishna temple on the Pampa, home of the snake boats. (Morning only · dress code)
11:00 AM — Aranmula kannadi workshop: The metal mirror, cast and polished by hand. Lunch after, own expense. (Buying is optional)
2:00 PM — Parumala & Niranam churches: St Gregorios' tomb at Parumala, then Niranam's old church, linked by tradition to St Thomas. (Modest dress)
5:15 PM — Drop-off: Pathanamthitta, Thiruvalla, Chengannur, or your own stop on the way
PTA_ARANMULA.gtk:
🛕 Temple rules: Most Kerala temples admit only Hindus inside; other guests see the gateway, pond and river from outside. Men: shirts off and dhoti or trousers; women: saree, churidar or long skirt. Footwear stays in the vehicle.
🪞 The Aranmula mirror: Made from a secret metal alloy, polished until the metal itself reflects — a GI-tagged craft. Genuine mirrors are costly: buy only from the workshop, with its certificate.
🚣 Festivals & crowds: Aug–Sept brings the Uthrattathi snake-boat race and Vallasadya feasts at Aranmula — ask us for dates. Parumala Perunnal (early Nov) draws huge crowds; we may change the order that week.
🚉 Pickup points: Pathanamthitta first, then Thiruvalla, then Chengannur — we share exact times the evening before. Drop-off at Thiruvalla, Chengannur, then Pathanamthitta, or your own stop on the way.
PTA_ARANMULA.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Free drop within the city; Caretaker for 10+ guests
PTA_ARANMULA.exc: Lunch; Offerings, mirror purchases; Tolls and parking (private trips)
PTA_ARANMULA.carry: Temple dress (dhoti / saree / churidar); Easy slip-on footwear; Hat and sunscreen; Cash for offerings and snacks

PTA_PERUNTHENARUVI.desc: Watch the Pampa spread wide and crash over a broad shelf of rock at Perunthenaruvi, visit Erumely's Vavar mosque and Sastha temple on the Sabarimala trail, then take tea by the river at Ranni.
PTA_PERUNTHENARUVI.itin:
7:30 AM — Pickup: Pathanamthitta KSRTC stand · Thiruvalla station · Chengannur station (Thiruvalla 7:30 · Chengannur 7:50 · PTA 8:30)
9:45 AM — Perunthenaruvi Falls: A wide waterfall on the Pampa, tumbling over black rock shelves in the forest. (Closed Tuesdays · entry own expense)
12:00 PM — Erumely: Vavar mosque and the Dharma Sastha temple, both visited by Sabarimala pilgrims. Lunch here, own expense. (Modest dress)
2:45 PM — Pampa at Ranni: Tea and a short walk by the river in the old market town of Ranni.
5:00 PM — Drop-off: Pathanamthitta, Thiruvalla, Chengannur, or your own stop on the way
PTA_PERUNTHENARUVI.gtk:
💧 At the falls: No bathing or wading — the rocks are slippery and the current is deceptively strong. Guests stay behind the railings and on marked paths; children held by the hand.
🗓️ Days & seasons: Perunthenaruvi is closed on Tuesdays — we don't run this tour that day. Fullest just after the monsoon; in heavy rain the falls may be closed for safety.
🕌 Erumely: Pilgrims of every faith visit the Vavar mosque; the temple follows its own entry rules. Modest dress. In the Sabarimala season (Nov–Jan) Erumely is packed with pilgrims — we may shorten this stop.
🚉 Pickup points: Thiruvalla first, then Chengannur, then Pathanamthitta — we share exact times the evening before. Drop-off in the reverse order, or at your own stop on the way.
PTA_PERUNTHENARUVI.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Free drop within the city; Caretaker for 10+ guests
PTA_PERUNTHENARUVI.exc: Lunch; Waterfall entry; Tolls and parking (private trips)
PTA_PERUNTHENARUVI.carry: Sandals or shoes with grip; Clothes covering shoulders and knees; Hat and sunscreen; Cash for entry and snacks

PTA_ALAPPUZHA.desc: Cross Kuttanad's paddy country on the AC road, glide through Alappuzha's canals on a shikara, walk the old pier and 1862 lighthouse, then meet the stone Buddha of Karumadi.
PTA_ALAPPUZHA.itin:
7:00 AM — Pickup: Pathanamthitta KSRTC stand · Thiruvalla station · Chengannur station (PTA 7:00 · Chengannur 7:45 · Thiruvalla 8:05)
9:30 AM — Shikara canal ride: About 2½ hours on Punnamada lake, narrow canals and paddy fields. (Boat paid direct)
12:15 PM — Lunch & Alappuzha beach: Karimeen lunch in town (own expense), then the old pier and promenade. (No swimming here)
2:00 PM — Alappuzha lighthouse: The 1862 lighthouse — climb up for views over the coast. (Tower: check timings)
3:15 PM — Karumadi Kuttan: A centuries-old black-stone Buddha by a quiet canal near Ambalappuzha.
5:45 PM — Drop-off: Pathanamthitta, Thiruvalla, Chengannur, or your own stop on the way
PTA_ALAPPUZHA.gtk:
🛶 The boat ride: Shikaras are run by licensed operators near Finishing Point; the fare is paid direct to the operator. Life jackets for everyone; children always with an adult.
🌊 Beach safety: No swimming at Alappuzha beach — strong currents. No sea bathing at all in the monsoon months.
🌧️ Kuttanad roads: Parts of the AC road and Kuttanad roads can flood after heavy rain — we then take the NH 66 route instead. If traffic is bad, we shorten the lighthouse stop, not the boat ride.
🚉 Pickup points: Pathanamthitta first, then Chengannur, then Thiruvalla — we share exact times the evening before. Drop-off at Thiruvalla, Chengannur, then Pathanamthitta, or your own stop on the way.
PTA_ALAPPUZHA.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Free drop within the city; Caretaker for 10+ guests
PTA_ALAPPUZHA.exc: Shikara fare (paid direct); Lunch and lighthouse entry; Tolls and parking (private trips)
PTA_ALAPPUZHA.carry: Hat and sunscreen; Light cotton clothes; Cash for the boat and snacks; Sandals for the beach

PTA_GAVI.desc: A full private day through the Gavi rainforest: in at Angamoozhy, past the Sabarigiri dams and Gavi lake, out to Vandiperiyar's tea country and home over Kuttikkanam.
PTA_GAVI.itin:
6:00 AM — Pickup: From your door — home, hotel, Pathanamthitta KSRTC stand, or Thiruvalla / Chengannur station (earlier start). (Breakfast at Seethathode)
8:30 AM — Angamoozhy check post: Forest pass check at the Kochandi gate; the one-way forest road to Gavi starts here. (Online pass booked ahead)
9:30 AM — Moozhiyar, Kakki & Anathode: Dams and blue reservoirs of the Sabarigiri project in deep forest, watching for deer, birds and elephants. (Photos from the road only)
12:30 PM — Gavi lake: Lunch at Gavi, a boat ride on the lake and the cardamom-forest views. (Lunch and boating paid direct)
3:45 PM — Vallakkadavu & Vandiperiyar: Exit check post, then tea estates and a tea break at Vandiperiyar.
7:30 PM — Drop-off: Down the ghat via Kuttikkanam, Mundakayam, Erumely and Ranni to your door.
PTA_GAVI.gtk:
🛂 Forest pass: Private vehicles need a Gavi pass booked online before the trip; numbers per day are limited. Entry at Angamoozhy is only in the morning window — that's why we start at 6:00 AM.
➡️ One-way road: Vehicles from Angamoozhy must exit at Vallakkadavu (Vandiperiyar) the same day — no U-turn. No stops off the road, no music, no plastic, no alcohol in the forest.
🗓️ Closures: Gavi closes for a few days around Makaravilakku (mid-January) and on heavy-rain alerts. We re-confirm the forest status the day before your trip.
📵 No signal: Mobile network is mostly absent between Angamoozhy and Gavi. Carry snacks, water and any medicines you need — shops are few.
PTA_GAVI.inc: Private vehicle and driver; Full Gavi forest loop; Driver bata; No waiting charges
PTA_GAVI.exc: Meals; Forest passes and boating; Tolls and parking
PTA_GAVI.carry: Photo ID for the forest pass; Light jacket and raincoat; Snacks and water (no plastic litter); Cash — few ATMs or card machines

PTA_SABARIMALA.desc: Your own vehicle from Pathanamthitta, Thiruvalla or Chengannur station to Nilakkal base camp for the 2026-27 season, with an Erumely stop if you wish — the driver waits to bring you home.
PTA_SABARIMALA.itin:
≈6:30 AM — Pickup: From your door in Pathanamthitta — or Thiruvalla / Chengannur station (earlier start). (Example: 10 AM slot)
On the road — Via Vadasserikkara & Laha: About 50 km from Pathanamthitta town, the last stretch on a forest ghat.
Optional — Via Ranni & Erumely: Petta Thullal at the Petta Sastha temple and a visit to Vavar Palli; we start about an hour earlier. (Tell us when booking)
≈8:15 AM — Nilakkal base camp: Private vehicles stop here; KSRTC chain buses take you on to Pampa. (Bus fare paid direct)
Day — Pampa, the climb & darshan: About 5 km uphill on foot to Sannidhanam, darshan, and the walk back. (Virtual Queue booked by you)
Night — Home: Your driver waits at Nilakkal and brings you home the same night.
PTA_SABARIMALA.gtk:
📱 Virtual Queue: Book your darshan slot yourself at sabarimalaonline.org; carry the QR coupon and the same photo ID. Spot-booking counters are limited — don't count on them.
🅿️ Nilakkal & Pampa: Private vehicles are not allowed to Pampa — KSRTC chain buses run from Nilakkal. Save your driver's number and the parking block.
🗓️ Season 2026-27: The temple opens on 16 Nov 2026; Mandala Pooja is on 27 Dec; Makaravilakku in mid-January 2027. Peak days bring police holds and long queues — we re-confirm before you travel.
🚆 Coming by train?: We meet you at Chengannur or Thiruvalla station and bring you back for your train. Share the train number — we track delays.
PTA_SABARIMALA.inc: Private vehicle and driver for the day; Erumely stop on request; Driver bata; No waiting charges at Nilakkal
PTA_SABARIMALA.exc: KSRTC Nilakkal–Pampa bus; Meals and offerings; Virtual Queue booking (done by you); Tolls and parking
PTA_SABARIMALA.carry: QR coupon and photo ID; Irumudi kettu; Torch and a warm layer; Your medicines and water

PTA_TRV.desc: Flying out of Trivandrum? Start at your own door in Pathanamthitta, Thiruvalla or Chengannur and step out at the right terminal — or land in Trivandrum and we drive you home.
PTA_TRV.itin:
Pickup — Your door: Home or hotel in Pathanamthitta, Thiruvalla, Chengannur, Adoor or nearby — at the time we agree for your flight.
On the road — ~115 km on the MC Road: About 3–3.5 hours via Adoor, Kottarakkara and Venjaramoodu, with a short break on the way.
Drop-off — Trivandrum International Airport: T1 domestic or T2 international (Chakkai). Reverse trips start from the arrivals exit. (No waiting charges on arrivals)
PTA_TRV.gtk:
✈️ Timing your trip: Leave at least 6.5 hours before an international flight and 5.5 hours before a domestic one. Town jams at Adoor, Kottarakkara and in Trivandrum city can add time.
🛫 Two terminals: T1 (domestic) and T2 (international, Chakkai) are on opposite sides of the runway. Check your ticket and tell us the terminal.
🧳 Luggage: Hatchbacks and sedans suit 2–3 people with check-in bags. Families with large bags: choose an MPV, Premium SUV or Traveller.
🔁 Landing in Trivandrum?: Share your flight number; we track delays and meet you at arrivals. We track your flight — no waiting charges if it lands late.
PTA_TRV.inc: Door-to-door pickup; No waiting charges on arrivals; Driver bata; Fuel and per-km charges
PTA_TRV.exc: Tolls and airport parking; Meals on the way
PTA_TRV.carry: Passport / ID and tickets; Flight number shared with us; Terminal (T1 / T2) noted; A light snack for the drive

PTA_COK.desc: Flying out of Cochin International? Start at your own door in Pathanamthitta, Thiruvalla or Chengannur and step out at the right terminal — or land in Kochi and we drive you home.
PTA_COK.itin:
Pickup — Your door: Home or hotel in Pathanamthitta, Thiruvalla, Chengannur, Kozhencherry or nearby — at the time we agree for your flight.
On the road — ~145 km on the MC Road: About 3.5–4 hours via Thiruvalla, Kottayam, Muvattupuzha and Perumbavoor, with a refreshment break.
Drop-off — Cochin International Airport: Domestic (T1) or international (T3) departures. Reverse trips start from the arrivals exit. (No waiting charges on arrivals)
PTA_COK.gtk:
✈️ Timing your trip: Leave at least 7 hours before an international flight and 6 hours before a domestic one. Kottayam, Muvattupuzha and Perumbavoor towns jam at peak hours — we plan around them.
🛫 Which terminal?: Domestic flights use T1; international flights use T3. Check your ticket and tell us — we drop you at the right kerb.
🧳 Luggage: Hatchbacks and sedans suit 2–3 people with check-in bags. Families with large bags: choose an MPV, Premium SUV or Traveller.
🔁 Landing in Kochi?: Share your flight number; we track delays and meet you at the arrivals exit with a name board. We track your flight — no waiting charges if it lands late.
PTA_COK.inc: Door-to-door pickup; No waiting charges on arrivals; Driver bata; Fuel and per-km charges
PTA_COK.exc: Tolls and airport parking; Meals on the way
PTA_COK.carry: Passport / ID and tickets; Flight number shared with us; Terminal (T1 / T3) noted; A light snack for the drive

PTA_THEKKADY.desc: Walk a cardamom and pepper plantation, catch a Kathakali or Kalaripayattu show, and take the morning boat into the Periyar Tiger Reserve — about four hours from Pathanamthitta.
PTA_THEKKADY.itin:
Day 1 · 7:00 AM — Pickup & drive: From your door, Pathanamthitta, Thiruvalla or Chengannur; about 115 km via Ranni, Erumely and the Kuttikkanam ghat, roughly 4 hours.
Day 1 · afternoon — Spice plantation tour: Cardamom, pepper, cinnamon and coffee with a local guide. (Paid direct)
Day 1 · evening — Kathakali or Kalaripayattu: Kerala's classical dance-drama or martial art at a Kumily theatre. Overnight in Thekkady. (Optional, paid direct)
Day 2 · 7:30 AM — Periyar Lake boat cruise: The first sailing — the best time to see elephants, gaur and deer at the water's edge. (Limited seats · tickets in advance)
Day 2 · late morning — Chellarkovil viewpoint: A cliff-edge view over the Cumbum valley and Tamil Nadu plains.
Day 2 · ~5 PM — Drive home: Down the ghat after lunch; back at your door by early evening.
PTA_THEKKADY.gtk:
🛶 Periyar boating: Only a few sailings a day with limited seats — we help you book tickets in advance. Animal sightings are never guaranteed; boats stop in storms.
🌿 Spice shopping: Buy from plantations or fixed-price shops in Kumily. Leeches on plantation paths in the wet season — wear socks.
🏨 Your stay: You book your hotel in Kumily or on Thekkady Road. Your driver's night allowance is in our price.
🛣️ The drive: Ghat road after Mundakayam — carry motion sickness tablets if needed. Sabarimala season (mid-Nov to mid-Jan) jams Erumely — we start earlier.
PTA_THEKKADY.inc: Private vehicle and driver for 2 days; All Thekkady sightseeing drives; Driver bata and night allowance; No waiting charges
PTA_THEKKADY.exc: Your hotel; Meals; Boat, plantation and show tickets; Tolls and parking
PTA_THEKKADY.carry: Light jacket; Walking shoes; Binoculars; Cash for tickets

PTA_MUNNAR.desc: Waterfalls on the climb, tea estates as far as you can see and the Nilgiri tahr of Eravikulam — Kerala's favourite hill station, about six hours from Pathanamthitta.
PTA_MUNNAR.itin:
Day 1 · 5:30 AM — Pickup & drive up: From your door, Pathanamthitta, Thiruvalla or Chengannur; about 195 km via Kottayam, Muvattupuzha and Kothamangalam, roughly 6–7 hours with breaks.
Day 1 · 10:15 AM — Cheeyappara & Valara falls: Roadside waterfalls in the Neriamangalam forest — a short photo stop. (Fullest in the monsoon)
Day 1 · afternoon — Tea Museum: How tea goes from leaf to cup, at Nullatanni. Lunch in Munnar town first. (Closed Mondays · entry own expense)
Day 1 · late afternoon — Mattupetty Dam & Echo Point: Lake views and optional boating on the Top Station road. Overnight in Munnar. (Stay booked by you)
Day 2 · morning — Eravikulam National Park: Park buses take you up Rajamala to see the Nilgiri tahr. (Tickets online · closed ~Feb–Mar)
Day 2 · ~7:30 PM — Drive home: Leave Munnar by 1 PM; back at your door by late evening.
PTA_MUNNAR.gtk:
🐐 Eravikulam: Tickets are sold online in time slots — book a few days ahead; we can help. Closed for the tahr calving season, usually February–March; then we go to Top Station instead.
🍃 Tea & spices: Tea estates are private land — photograph from the roadside. Spice gardens at Pallivasal and Kallar are optional, paid direct.
🏨 Your stay: You book your hotel; Munnar town, Pothamedu and Chithirapuram are popular. Your driver's night allowance is in our price.
🧥 Weather & roads: Cool mornings, cold in December–January — bring a layer. A long drive each way: we start early so the ghat is done in daylight.
PTA_MUNNAR.inc: Private vehicle and driver for 2 days; All Munnar sightseeing drives; Driver bata and night allowance; No waiting charges
PTA_MUNNAR.exc: Your hotel; Meals; Park, museum and boating fees; Tolls and parking
PTA_MUNNAR.carry: Warm jacket; Walking shoes; Motion sickness tablets; Cash for entry fees

PTA_VAGAMON.desc: A long private day in Kerala's quiet hills: misty pine forest, rolling green meadows, the Kurisumala skyline and late-afternoon views from Thangalpara, about three hours from Pathanamthitta.
PTA_VAGAMON.itin:
6:30 AM — Pickup: From your door — home, hotel, Pathanamthitta, Thiruvalla or Chengannur. Breakfast at Kanjirappally.
9:45 AM — Pine forest: Walk under tall pines on the slopes just outside Vagamon town. (Entry own expense)
11:00 AM — Vagamon meadows & lake: Rolling grass hills with the Kurisumala view, then the calm lake ringed by tea. Lunch in town.
2:00 PM — Adventure park, Kolahalamedu: Paragliding in season and the glass bridge, when open. (Paid direct · operators confirm)
4:00 PM — Thangalpara: Hilltop rocks and a shrine with sweeping views over the valleys. (Easy uphill walk)
8:30 PM — Drop-off: Down via Erattupetta, Kanjirappally and Ranni, back to your door.
PTA_VAGAMON.gtk:
🪂 Paragliding & glass bridge: Paragliding runs in season and only when the weather allows; pay the operator directly. The glass bridge has been closed for strengthening — we confirm if it's open before your trip.
🌧️ Weather: Mist rolls in most afternoons; grass slopes are slippery after rain. Best from September to May; heavy-rain alerts can close viewpoints.
⏱️ A long day: About 3 hours each way on narrow hill and estate roads. Prefer a slower pace? Ask us for a 2-day trip with a night in Vagamon.
👟 Walking: Meadows, pine forest and Thangalpara involve short uphill walks. Elderly guests can enjoy most views close to the road.
PTA_VAGAMON.inc: Private vehicle and driver; All Vagamon sightseeing drives; Driver bata; No waiting charges
PTA_VAGAMON.exc: Meals; Entry, paragliding and park tickets; Tolls and parking
PTA_VAGAMON.carry: Light jacket; Walking shoes with grip; Raincoat or umbrella; Cash for entry fees

PTA_KANYAKUMARI.desc: India's southern tip: the wooden palace of the Travancore kings, a sunset and a sunrise where three seas meet, and a ferry to Vivekananda Rock and the Thiruvalluvar statue.
PTA_KANYAKUMARI.itin:
Day 1 · 6:00 AM — Pickup & drive: From your door, Pathanamthitta or Chengannur. About 210 km via Adoor, the MC Road and Trivandrum, 5–6 hours with breaks.
Day 1 · 11:15 AM — Padmanabhapuram Palace: The Travancore kings' carved wooden palace at Thuckalay, on the way. (Closed Mondays · entry own expense)
Day 1 · evening — Sunset at Kanyakumari: Watch the sun go down at the tip of India. Overnight in Kanyakumari. (Stay booked by you)
Day 2 · ~6 AM — Sunrise over three seas: The famous sunrise from the shore by the temple.
Day 2 · 8:00 AM — Vivekananda Rock & Thiruvalluvar statue: Government ferry to the rock memorial; a glass bridge links it to the statue. (Ferry paid direct · go early)
Day 2 · late morning — Kumari Amman Temple: The ancient shore temple of the virgin goddess. (Men remove shirts · dress code)
Day 2 · ~8 PM — Home: About 210 km back — Suchindram temple on the way if you wish.
PTA_KANYAKUMARI.gtk:
🛂 Tamil Nadu entry: Kanyakumari is in Tamil Nadu: interstate permit, border tax and tolls are billed at actual cost. We arrange the permit before your trip.
⛴️ The Rock ferry: Government ferries run from about 8 AM to 4 PM; queues grow after 9 — go early. Tickets paid direct; ferries pause when the sea is rough.
🛕 Palace & temple: Padmanabhapuram Palace is closed on Mondays — on a Monday we visit Suchindram instead. Kumari Amman: men remove shirts; modest dress for all.
🏨 Your stay: You book your hotel; sea-view rooms near the sunrise point fill fast. Your driver's night allowance is in our price.
PTA_KANYAKUMARI.inc: Private vehicle and driver for 2 days; Palace, sunset & temple drives; Driver bata and night allowance; No waiting charges
PTA_KANYAKUMARI.exc: Your hotel; Meals; Ferry, palace and temple tickets; Permits, border tax, tolls, parking — at actuals
PTA_KANYAKUMARI.carry: Photo ID; Modest temple clothes; Hat and sunscreen; Cash for ferry and entry

PTA_PANDALAM.desc: Ayyappa's royal home at Pandalam, Kodumon's rare spider temple, Kadammanitta's Padayani ground and old Malayalappuzha — all before the noon closing.
PTA_PANDALAM.itin:
6:45 AM — Pickup: Pathanamthitta KSRTC stand · Thiruvalla station · Chengannur station (Thiruvalla 6:45 · Chengannur 7:05 · PTA 7:45)
8:05 AM — Kadammanitta Devi Temple: Bhadrakali temple; its ground hosts Padayani, the masked art of the April festival. (Dress code · see below)
9:00 AM — Malayalappuzha Devi Temple: Bhadrakali shrine said to be over 1,000 years old, with old murals and carvings. (Morning darshan)
10:15 AM — Kodumon Chilanthiyambalam: Palliyara Bhagavathy, the 'spider temple', famed for healing spider bites. (Modest dress)
11:15 AM — Pandalam · Valiyakoikkal: Ayyappa's family temple in the palace grounds. Lunch in Pandalam, own expense. (Before noon · dress code)
3:00 PM — Drop-off: Pathanamthitta, Thiruvalla, Chengannur, or your own stop on the way
PTA_PANDALAM.gtk:
🛕 Temple rules: Most Kerala temples admit only Hindus inside; other guests see the gateway, grounds and pond from outside. Men: shirts off and dhoti or trousers; women: saree, churidar or long skirt. Footwear stays in the vehicle.
👑 Pandalam palace: The palace is the royal family's home, not a museum — guests see the grounds and temple, not the rooms. The Thiruvabharanam (Ayyappa's ornaments) are shown only in the Sabarimala season, about mid-Nov to early Jan; viewing is not part of this tour.
🎭 About Padayani: Padayani is Kadammanitta's festival art: huge painted masks of areca-palm sheath, drums and dance through the night, in April (Medam 1–10). This tour visits the temple and its ground; no performance on normal days. Ask us for festival dates.
🚉 Pickup points: Thiruvalla first, then Chengannur, then Pathanamthitta — we share exact times the evening before. Drop-off in the reverse order, or at your own stop on the way.
PTA_PANDALAM.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Free drop within the city; Caretaker for 10+ guests
PTA_PANDALAM.exc: Lunch; Offerings and poojas; Tolls and parking (private trips)
PTA_PANDALAM.carry: Temple dress (dhoti / saree / churidar); Easy slip-on footwear; Hat and sunscreen; Cash for offerings and snacks

PTA_THIRUVALLA.desc: Kaviyoor's 8th-century rock-cut cave shrine and its Hanuman temple with carved epics, then evening lamps at Thiruvalla's Sreevallabha temple, where Kathakali is danced as an offering on most nights.
PTA_THIRUVALLA.itin:
2:00 PM — Pickup: Pathanamthitta KSRTC stand · Thiruvalla station · Chengannur station (PTA 2:00 · Chengannur 2:45 · Thiruvalla 3:05)
3:30 PM — Kaviyoor cave temple: A Shiva shrine cut into one rock above the Manimala river. (Protected monument)
4:45 PM — Kaviyoor Mahadeva Temple: Hanuman shrine and carved wooden epics. Tea after, own expense. (Dress code · see below)
6:15 PM — Sreevallabha Temple: Evening lamps at a great Vishnu temple. Dinner after, own expense. (Hindus only inside)
8:45 PM — Kathakali offering: Offered by devotees on most nights; we watch the first hour. (Free · most nights)
9:50 PM — Drop-off: Pathanamthitta, Thiruvalla, Chengannur, or your own stop on the way
PTA_THIRUVALLA.gtk:
🎭 Kathakali night: Devotees offer Kathakali here on most nights and it runs late; we watch the opening hour or so and leave at about 9:45. On a night with no booking we stay longer at the evening lamps and drop you earlier.
🛕 Temple rules: Most Kerala temples admit only Hindus inside; other guests see the gateways and watch the Kathakali from outside. Men: shirts off and dhoti or trousers; women: saree, churidar or long skirt. Footwear stays in the vehicle.
🪨 Kaviyoor: The cave temple is a short drive from the Mahadeva temple; a few steps and uneven rock. Some listings say the cave is closed on Mondays — we confirm before your date.
🚉 Pickup points: Pathanamthitta first, then Chengannur, then Thiruvalla — we share exact times the evening before. Drop-off at Thiruvalla about 9:50 PM, Chengannur 10:10, Pathanamthitta about 10:50.
PTA_THIRUVALLA.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Free drop within the city; Caretaker for 10+ guests
PTA_THIRUVALLA.exc: Tea and dinner; Offerings and donations; Tolls and parking (private trips)
PTA_THIRUVALLA.carry: Temple dress (dhoti / saree / churidar); Easy slip-on footwear; Small torch or phone light; Mosquito repellent

PTA_EV_THIRUVABHARANAM.desc: Lord Ayyappa's gold ornaments leave Pandalam for Sabarimala, two days before Makaravilakku. See them at Valiyakoikkal temple, watch the send-off, then meet the procession on its route. Event dates: ≈Tue 12 Jan 2027 · from Pandalam (Estimate — confirm with Pandalam palace / TDB).
PTA_EV_THIRUVABHARANAM.itin:
7:00 AM — Pickup: Home, hotel, KSRTC stand, Thiruvalla / Chengannur station or TRV / COK Airport.
8:00 AM — Pandalam — see the ornaments: 15 km via Kaipattoor. The caskets are brought from the palace to Valiyakoikkal temple and opened for devotees. (Long queues)
1:00 PM — The procession sets off: Bearers carry the caskets on their heads; devotees watch the sky for the Krishna parunthu, a kite. (Very crowded)
Afternoon — Lunch & roadside darshan: Lunch on the way (own expense), then a temple on the route — Kulanada, Ullannoor or Aranmula — as it receives the procession. (Time varies)
7:30 PM — Home: Back home, to your hotel or the station.
PTA_EV_THIRUVABHARANAM.gtk:
💎 The ornaments: Thiruvabharanam is Ayyappa's set of gold ornaments, kept by the Pandalam royal family. Three caskets travel: the ornaments, the silver vessels and the flag. Bearers walk about 83 km in three days, halting at Ayroor Puthiyakavu and Laha, to adorn the deity on Makaravilakku.
🚧 Roads & crowds: Police close roads around the venue on the main days. Your driver drops you at the nearest open point and you walk the last stretch. Agree a meeting point and time with the driver before you get out — phone networks jam in big crowds.
📅 Date: The procession leaves Pandalam on 12 January, around 1 PM; Makaravilakku is expected on Thursday 14 January 2027. The palace and the Devaswom Board fix the time — we re-confirm before your trip.
🙏 Manners: Dress modestly; leave footwear where devotees ask. Many pilgrims keep the Sabarimala vow in black — make way for the bearers and the procession.
PTA_EV_THIRUVABHARANAM.inc: Private vehicle and driver for the day; Door-to-door, in Pathanamthitta or from your city; Driver waits through the event — no waiting charge; Driver bata (+ night allowance on late or 2-day trips)
PTA_EV_THIRUVABHARANAM.exc: Food and stay; Tolls and parking; Offerings
PTA_EV_THIRUVABHARANAM.carry: Modest clothes, easy footwear; Water and an umbrella; Cash for offerings and snacks; Phone, charged, with our number saved

PTA_EV_MARAMON.desc: One of Asia's largest Christian gatherings, on the dry sand-bed of the Pampa at Maramon. Sit on the sand under the great pandal for the classes and meetings — your driver waits and brings you home. Event dates: ≈14–21 Feb 2027 · Sunday to Sunday (Estimate — confirm with the Mar Thoma Church).
PTA_EV_MARAMON.itin:
7:30 AM — Pickup: Home, hotel, KSRTC stand, Thiruvalla / Chengannur station or TRV / COK Airport.
8:15 AM — Drop near Kozhencherry bridge: 14 km to Kozhencherry. We drop as close as the police allow; walk down to the sand-bed. (Walk the last stretch)
Morning — Bible classes & morning meeting: Classes for men, women and children, then the main meeting under the pandal. (Sit on the sand)
Midday — Lunch: Stalls on the sand-bed or hotels in Kozhencherry town. (Own expense)
Afternoon — Afternoon meeting: Led by a bishop; some afternoons speak on social evils. (Main meeting)
5:30 PM — Home: Pickup at the meeting point; back home, to your hotel or the station.
PTA_EV_MARAMON.gtk:
⛪ The convention: Held every February since 1895 by the Mar Thoma Evangelistic Association, the mission arm of the Mar Thoma Syrian Church. The pandal on the Pampa's dry riverbed holds well over a lakh; people of every church come.
🪑 On the sand: Most people sit on the sand — carry a mat or towel. Chairs are kept for the elderly and frail. A smaller pandal is set aside for families with children under five.
📅 Dates: Eight days, Sunday to Sunday, from the second Sunday of February — about 14 to 21 February 2027. We confirm the dates and the day's programme before your trip.
🚧 Roads & crowds: Police close roads around the venue on the main days. Your driver drops you at the nearest open point and you walk the last stretch. Agree a meeting point and time with the driver before you get out — phone networks jam in big crowds.
PTA_EV_MARAMON.inc: Private vehicle and driver for the day; Door-to-door, in Pathanamthitta or from your city; Driver waits through the event — no waiting charge; Driver bata (+ night allowance on late or 2-day trips)
PTA_EV_MARAMON.exc: Food and stay; Tolls and parking; Offerings, books and stalls
PTA_EV_MARAMON.carry: Mat or towel to sit on; Umbrella, cap and water; Bible and a notebook; Phone, charged, with our number saved

PTA_EV_PADAYANI.desc: Kadammanitta's Valiya Padayani — painted kolams of areca spathe dance to thappu drums by the light of coconut-leaf torches, from late night until dawn. Your own vehicle, a driver who waits, a ride home. Event dates: ≈Thu 22 Apr 2027 · Valiya Padayani night (Estimate — confirm with the temple).
PTA_EV_PADAYANI.itin:
9:30 PM — Pickup: Home, hotel, KSRTC stand, Thiruvalla / Chengannur station or TRV / COK Airport.
10:00 PM — Drop near Kadammanitta temple: About 7 km from Pathanamthitta town. We drop you as close as the police allow. (Walk the last stretch)
11:00 PM — Valiya Padayani begins: Thappu drums and torches; the kolams come out — Ganapathi, Marutha, Kalan, Yakshi. (Night ritual)
Small hours — The Bhairavi kolams: Giant kolams of areca spathes and palm leaves — the high point of the night. (Main moment)
4:00 AM — Home: Pickup at the meeting point; back home, to your hotel or the station.
PTA_EV_PADAYANI.gtk:
🔥 Padayani: A ritual art for the goddess Bhadrakali — painted masks (kolams) of areca spathe, danced to thappu drums by torchlight. The ten-day festival at Kadammanitta Devi temple starts on Medam 1; the Valiya Padayani is the big night.
📸 Respect: This is worship — keep clear of the dancers and the torches, and don't block the ground. Photograph only where the temple allows; follow its dress and entry rules.
📅 Date: We expect the Valiya Padayani on the night of Thursday 22 April 2027, from about 11 PM until dawn. We confirm the night with the temple before your trip.
🚧 Roads & crowds: Police close roads around the venue on the main days. Your driver drops you at the nearest open point and you walk the last stretch. Agree a meeting point and time with the driver before you get out — phone networks jam in big crowds.
PTA_EV_PADAYANI.inc: Private vehicle and driver for the day; Door-to-door, in Pathanamthitta or from your city; Driver waits through the event — no waiting charge; Driver bata (+ night allowance on late or 2-day trips)
PTA_EV_PADAYANI.exc: Food and stay; Tolls and parking; Offerings
PTA_EV_PADAYANI.carry: Torch and a light shawl; Mosquito repellent; Water bottle and snacks; Phone, charged, with our number saved

PTA_EV_ARANMULA.desc: Aranmula's sacred snake-boat race on the Pampa — fifty-odd palliyodams of the Parthasarathy temple, studded umbrellas and vanchipattu boat songs. We drop you near the venue and bring you home after the final. Event dates: ≈Fri 17 Sep 2027 · Uthrattathi day (Estimate — confirm with the Palliyoda Seva Sangham).
PTA_EV_ARANMULA.itin:
10:00 AM — Pickup: Home, hotel, KSRTC stand, Thiruvalla / Chengannur station or TRV / COK Airport.
10:45 AM — Drop near Aranmula: 17 km via Kozhencherry or the police diversion. Walk to the Satram pavilion. (Walk the last stretch)
Afternoon — Water procession: The palliyodams sail past, crews singing vanchipattu under studded umbrellas. (Find a spot early)
3:00 PM — Heats and the final: Batch A and Batch B heats; the Mannam Trophy finals run into the evening. (Times on the day's schedule)
7:00 PM — Pickup at the meeting point: Agreed with your driver at the drop. Roads clear slowly after the race. (Expect slow traffic)
8:30 PM — Home: Back home, to your hotel or the station.
PTA_EV_ARANMULA.gtk:
🛶 The race: Palliyodams are the sacred snake boats of Aranmula Parthasarathy temple, each from a village along the Pampa — 51 took part in 2026. Crews row in rhythm to vanchipattu boat songs; the Mannam Trophy goes to the batch winners.
🚧 Roads & crowds: Police close roads around the venue on the main days. Your driver drops you at the nearest open point and you walk the last stretch. Agree a meeting point and time with the driver before you get out — phone networks jam in big crowds.
📅 Date: The race is held on Uthrattathi day in the month of Chingam — we expect Friday 17 September 2027. The Palliyoda Seva Sangham fixes the date — we re-confirm before your trip.
☀️ On the bank: Carry a cap, umbrella and water; the riverbank gets hot and crowded. Keep children away from the water's edge and the river steps.
PTA_EV_ARANMULA.inc: Private vehicle and driver for the day; Door-to-door, in Pathanamthitta or from your city; Driver waits through the event — no waiting charge; Driver bata (+ night allowance on late or 2-day trips)
PTA_EV_ARANMULA.exc: Food and stay; Tolls and parking; Gallery passes, if any
PTA_EV_ARANMULA.carry: Cap, umbrella, sunglasses; Water bottle; Cash for snacks; Phone, charged, with our number saved

PTA_VELANKANNI.desc: From Pathanamthitta over the Aryankavu pass to the Basilica of Our Lady of Good Health — Mass, Our Lady's Tank, Morning Star Church, candle prayers and the shore.
PTA_VELANKANNI.itin:
Day 1 · 4:00 AM — Pickup: Pathanamthitta KSRTC stand · Thiruvalla station · Chengannur station (Thiruvalla 4:00 · PTA 5:00)
Day 1 · evening — Velankanni Basilica: Over the Aryankavu pass in daylight; check in, then evening prayer at the shrine. (Lodge list shared)
Day 2 · morning — Mass & Our Lady's Tank: Mass, Our Lady's Tank and the Way of the Cross path. (Modest dress)
Day 2 · late morning — Morning Star Church & museum: The upper church and the museum of offerings; lunch own expense.
Day 2 · evening — Candle prayers & the shore: A rest after lunch; evening rosary and candles at the shrine, sunset on the beach. (No swimming)
Day 3 · ~6:30 PM — Drop-off: Pathanamthitta, Thiruvalla, Chengannur, or your own stop on the way (We leave at 5 AM)
PTA_VELANKANNI.gtk:
⛪ At the shrine: Dress modestly; footwear off where asked, quiet in the queues. Masses run through the day in Tamil, English and other languages; we confirm the Malayalam Mass time.
🌊 The beach: The sea here is rough and drownings are reported — paddle only, never swim. Crowds are big: agree a meeting point and keep children close.
🏨 Your room: You book your own room; we share a list of pilgrim lodges near the shrine. Driver bata and night allowance are in our price.
🛣️ Long drive days: About 12 hours each way with breaks every 2–3 hours; the Aryankavu pass in daylight. Interstate permit, border tax and tolls are at actual cost.
PTA_VELANKANNI.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Driver bata and night allowance; Caretaker for 10+ guests
PTA_VELANKANNI.exc: Your room; Meals; Offerings and museum entry; Permits, border tax, tolls, parking — at actuals
PTA_VELANKANNI.carry: Modest clothes for church; Photo ID; Light shawl or scarf; Cash for offerings and candles
